title: Resume Theme Preset
description: Presentation-only styling for a resume render. Deliberately MINIMAL: just enough to tweak color, font, size, and margins, plus the autofit floors that bound how far the single-page autofit routine may shrink things. STRICT: unknown keys are rejected so style-key typos surface as warnings.

family.description: Font family. Use a Calibri-metric-compatible family (Carlito) for faithful, reflow-free rendering via LibreOffice.

baseSize.description: Base body font size in points. Bullets/prose use this; other sizes derive from it via the ratios below.

sizes.description: Font sizes in points. If a value is null/absent it is derived from font.baseSize.

small.description: Small text (domain notes, meta lines, links).

spacing.description: Vertical rhythm in points (converted to twips internally).

sectionAfter.description: Space after a section heading (before its content).

lineHeight.description: Line height multiple for body text.

leftCellPct.description: Fraction of usable width given to the left (name/tagline) cell; the rest holds right-aligned contacts.

nonBreakingHyphens.description: Replace hyphens in compound terms with U+2011 to prevent raw-stream extractors dropping them at line-wrap boundaries.

autofit.description: Floors and step sizes bounding the single-page autofit routine (used only when --auto-fit-to-single-page is passed).

minBodySize.description: Body font will not shrink below this (pt). ATS-safe floor is ~10pt; 9.5 permitted as a last resort.

minMargin.description: Margins will not shrink below this (inches). ATS-safe floor is 0.5in.

spacingStep.description: Line-height / spacing decrement factor per iteration.
